params.name: youth_hinge

payload.local_ablation: Local ablation (contribution replaced by train mean): AUC 0.9078->0.9002, acc 0.8520->0.8502, mean |dlogit| 0.739. Contribution by age z: 0.463 for z>=-0.264 (age>=35 y, est. mean 38.6 sd 13.7); 0.590 at 34 y ... 3.335 at 17 y (step +0.161/yr). 8375 and 3328 active on 100% of rows (pure linear relays); 599 active on 43.05%.

params.hypothesis: Hypothesis: a youth bonus to P(<=50K). Age enters only via the ReLU hinge 599=relu(-1.763*age-0.494), active below z=-0.280 (~35 years, using est. mean 38.6/sd 13.7 y). 8375 and 3328 are always active, so they are linear relays and the contribution collapses to 1.258*relu(-1.763*age-0.494)+0.463: flat (0.463) at 35+ years, +0.161 logit per year younger, 3.335 at age 17. Evidence: closed form from get_formula; line plot on full train (n=39073) shows the hinge, corr -0.78; local ablation AUC 0.9078->0.9002. Supported.

params.hypothesis: Hypothesis: capital gain's whole effect, a concave piecewise-linear penalty on P(<=50K). Contribution = -2.787*cg - 3.581*relu(0.8175*cg-0.453): slope -2.79 per sd below z=0.554 (~5.2k USD), -5.71 per sd above it. +0.41 logit at cg=0 (95% of rows), -9.0 at the 99th pct, -73.7 at 99,999 USD (output saturated to ~0). Evidence: closed form; line plot on full train, corr -0.997; ablation AUC 0.9078->0.8896, acc 0.852->0.832. The largest non-linear effect in the network. Supported.

params.hypothesis: Hypothesis: the network is an additive logistic model. logit P(<=50K) = 0.776 + sparse linear backbone over 40 direct inputs + sum of 7 child contributions, then sigmoid. Backbone (direct edges, standardised inputs): education-num -1.41, marital-status:2 (Married-civ-spouse) -0.73, relationship:5 (Wife) -0.56, relationship:0 (Husband) -0.56, relationship:3 (Own-child) +0.43, sex (Male) -0.42, hours-per-week -0.33, capital-loss -0.30, plus small workclass/occupation/education/country offsets. Children: capital_gain_penalty (concave piecewise-linear, kink ~5.2k USD), youth_hinge (+0.16 logit per year below ~35), and five near-inert categorical gates (Handlers-cleaners/Doctorate relay, Tech-support, Priv-house-serv, China, Asian-Pac offset).
